name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-signin-google
description: Sign in with Google into the kernel sign-in shell. Client id lives here.

clientId.label: Google client id
clientId.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud (….apps.googleusercontent.com). Required before Google Sign-in appears on the shop.
clientId.sectionDescription: Web client from Google Cloud. The kernel sign-in shell stays on Preferences; fill the client id to actually connect.

signupTokenTtl.label: Signup token TTL
signupTokenTtl.description: How long a first-time Google signup token stays valid (for example 10m). Raise only if customers need longer to finish.
